metadata.name: Daggerfall Unity
metadata.summary: Recreation of The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall in the Unity engine

content.value: Daggerfall Unity is an open-source recreation of the classic role-playing game The Elder Scrolls II: Daggerfall powered by the Unity engine. It allows players to experience the expansive world of the original title natively on modern operating systems without emulation, pairing classic gameplay with engine modernizations and hundreds of bug fixes.
The project preserves the charm of the original game while providing quality-of-life enhancements and an extensible architecture for community mods, requiring only the original game assets to run.

items.value: Native cross-platform execution without relying on DOS emulation
High-resolution widescreen support alongside optional classic 320x200 and 640x400 retro modes
Enhanced modern lighting, expanded draw distances, and smooth first-person controls
Hundreds of bug fixes and gameplay quality-of-life enhancements over the original DOS release
Extensive community modding and translation support
